I can't confirm yet. A dispute has to be filed under a specific reason code, and each code has its own eligibility rules. I'll check eligibility once I know what happened with TX-0401.

Please tell me which of these applies:

- **You were charged twice for the same purchase.** I would check duplicate_charge. TX-0402 (EUR 240.00, TechMart Online, 2026-07-14) may be relevant.
- **You did not make the payment.** I would check unauthorized_debit or fraud_card_not_present.
- **You paid but did not receive the goods.** I would check goods_not_received.
- **You paid for a service that was not provided.** I would check service_not_rendered.

If none of these fits, describe what happened and I will work out the right code. Nothing will be filed without your confirmation.
